description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Reaper trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
